scientific_rationale.primary_rule_choice: q10=0.60 is primary because it was the single post-discovery recalibration frozen before a fresh independent-seed validation bank and was prospectively confirmed in 05y6.
scientific_rationale.historical_rule_role: q10=0.40 remains a prespecified historical sensitivity analysis and never replaces the primary q10=0.60 result based on TARGET behavior.
scientific_rationale.scope_limit: q10=0.60 is a targeted prospectively validated recalibration, not a rerun or replacement of the complete historical 05f3e simulation gate.

primary_retention_rule.provenance: single q10 recalibration prospectively confirmed in frozen 05y6 fresh-seed validation

target_application_decision_policy.rule_if_primary_retains_zero_factors: Report zero retained factors as the primary result. Do not relax q10 or substitute q10=0.40. Any downstream factor-specific analysis requiring at least one retained factor is reported as not estimable under the primary rule. Run q10=0.40 only as the separately labeled prespecified sensitivity.
target_application_decision_policy.rule_if_primary_retains_few_nonzero_fact: Do not invent a minimum retained-factor count and do not relax thresholds. Use all factors retained by the frozen primary rule for analyses that are mathematically and methodologically defined under the downstream frozen plan; otherwise report the corresponding analysis as not estimable. The q10=0.40 analysis remains sensitivity only.
target_application_decision_policy.rule_if_primary_and_sensitivity_disagree: Report both results with their prespecified labels. Do not select whichever rule yields the more favorable biological or outcome result; primary interpretation follows q10=0.60.

historical_gate_boundaries.claim_for_q10_060: Only the targeted fresh G19 specificity endpoint and fresh STANDARD truth-factor recovery safety endpoint were prospectively evaluated in 05y6.

D05_interpretation.historical_numeric_basis: 67.5% conditional mixed-support localization under the historical q10=0.40 gate
D05_interpretation.allowed_wording: Mixed/view-specific support attribution remains conservatively interpreted because its quantitative simulation basis was established under the historical q10=0.40 gate and was not recharacterized for q10=0.60.

05y6_results_lock.rewrite_policy: 05y6 prospective result is immutable. No alternative q10, median, inclusion, or other frontier point may be selected using this fresh validation bank.

rewrite_policy: 06a is immutable after any TARGET model fit, retained-factor result, biological annotation result, or clinical outcome result is viewed. q10=0.60 remains primary and q10=0.40 remains sensitivity regardless of which produces a more favorable TARGET result.
